sources.cite: AWS Lambda Developer Guide, Creating and configuring an Amazon SQS event source mapping
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. Relevant text: by default, after an error 'all messages in that batch return to the queue. After the visibility timeout, the messages become visible to Lambda again'; set the visibility timeout to at least six times the function timeout; Lambda refuses a function timeout longer than the queue's visibility timeout. The case's consumer is a container worker, not Lambda, so this check does not protect it. The SQS developer guide page on the visibility timeout (read 2026-11-18): 'The default visibility timeout for a queue is 30 seconds'; ChangeMessageVisibility extends it; 'due to the at-least-once delivery model of Amazon SQS, there's no absolute guarantee that a message won't be delivered more than once', so consumers must tolerate duplicates.
